title: Inspection video + defect adjudication
description: Blindly review inspection video, manufacturing evidence, quality criteria, and damage analogues before defect disposition.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: inspection-video-defect-adjudication
  title: Inspection video + defect adjudication
  description: Blindly review inspection video, manufacturing evidence, quality criteria, and damage analogues
    before defect disposition.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Blindly review inspection video, manufacturing evidence, quality criteria, and damage analogues
    before defect disposition.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 6
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - approval
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Source material and instructions
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - asset
          - instructions
        properties:
          asset:
            type: string
            contentMediaType: video/*
          instructions:
            type: string
        x-ladder-input-mode: video
    - id: role-1
      kind: agent
      name: Process Quality Engineer
      templateRef: mfg-02
      role: Quality engineer running SPC, capability studies, and defect investigations.
      prompt: You are a Process Quality Engineer. You judge process behavior from control charts and capability
        indices using the rules the chart supports, and you separate common-cause variation from a genuine
        special cause before anyone adjusts a setpoint. You call out tampering — reacting to noise as if it
        were signal — because over-adjustment is the most common way a stable process is made unstable.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - statistical-analysis
          - decision-analysis
          - domain-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:mes
          - mcp:historian
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-2
      kind: agent
      name: FMEA Facilitator
      templateRef: mfg-04
      role: Risk facilitator running failure mode and effects analysis to actionable controls.
      prompt: You are an FMEA Facilitator. You drive each function to its failure modes, effects, causes, and
        current controls, and you score severity, occurrence, and detection with the reasoning for each number
        written down. You treat a high-severity, low-detection mode as action-required even when its risk
        number looks acceptable, because an undetectable safety failure is not made safe by being rare.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - risk-analysis
          - evaluation
          - compliance-review
          - operations-planning
        tools:
          - read
        connectors:
          - mcp:plm
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-3
      kind: agent
      name: Claims Adjuster
      templateRef: insr-01
      role: Adjuster establishing coverage, causation, and quantum from the evidence on file.
      prompt: You are a Claims Adjuster. You establish coverage under the policy as written, causation from the
        evidence, and quantum from documented loss, keeping those three determinations separate. You state
        which element is unsupported rather than declining a claim on a general impression, because a denial
        that cannot name its policy provision and its evidence will not survive review.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - decision-analysis
          - quantitative-analysis
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - search
        connectors:
          - mcp:claims-system
        permissions:
          - read-only
          - pii-restricted
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-4
      kind: agent
      name: Imaging Interpretation Specialist
      templateRef: clin-01
      role: Imaging interpretation specialist supporting, never replacing, credentialed clinical review.
      prompt: Describe observable imaging findings with location, confidence, and limitations. Do not infer beyond
        the supplied study, and route all diagnostic conclusions and urgent findings to a credentialed
        clinician.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - image-understanding
          - clinical-safety
        tools:
          - read
        permissions:
          - read-sensitive
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: combine
      kind: aggregator
      name: Reconcile cross-area findings
      config:
        aggregation: vote
    - id: approval
      kind: approval
      name: Cross-functional authority approves release
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable and unresolved-item register
  edges:
    - id: e1
      from: intake
      to: role-1
      kind: data
    - id: e2
      from: intake
      to: role-2
      kind: data
    - id: e3
      from: intake
      to: role-3
      kind: data
    - id: e4
      from: intake
      to: role-4
      kind: data
    - id: e5
      from: role-1
      to: combine
      kind: data
    - id: e6
      from: role-2
      to: combine
      kind: data
    - id: e7
      from: role-3
      to: combine
      kind: data
    - id: e8
      from: role-4
      to: combine
      kind: data
    - id: e9
      from: combine
      to: approval
      kind: dependency
    - id: e10
      from: approval
      to: result
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
